name.value: Econo Lodge Inn & Suites - North Vancouver

description.value: A family-owned 95-room motel with an alpine aesthetic, situated 10 minutes north of downtown Vancouver near the Capilano Suspension Bridge, Grouse Mountain, and the Sea to Sky highway to Whistler. Room options range from standard queen beds to full kitchen suites and extended-stay units, making it a practical multi-night base for cyclists exploring the North Shore trail network. Free parking for vehicles and vans is highlighted, and the surrounding area offers direct access to hiking and biking trails.

address.value: 1748 Capilano Road, North Vancouver, BC V7P 3B4

raw_osm.name: Econo Lodge Inn & Suites - North Vancouver

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and directly corroborates the OSM address, phone number, and email. No mention of bicycle storage, bike racks, bike rooms, or any cycling-specific handling procedure appears anywhere on the site, so both required criteria are null. Amenity evidence (coin laundry, grab-and-go breakfast, Wi-Fi, nearby dining) comes from the /north-vancouver-hotel-amenities and /north-vancouver-hotel-rooms subpages; one anomaly is flagged: the /request-for-information subpage incorrectly refers to the property as 'Comfort Inn and Suites North Vancouver,' which appears to be a copy-paste error from a prior brand affiliation.
concerns: The /request-for-information subpage refers to the property as 'Comfort Inn and Suites North Vancouver' rather than 'Econo Lodge Inn & Suites' — likely a residual copy-paste error from a prior brand affiliation, but worth flagging as a name/brand inconsistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with a live website and fully confirmed contact details; a viable overnight stop for touring cyclists accessing the North Shore and Sea to Sky corridor.

Laundry.detail: On-site coin laundry listed on the amenities page and referenced on the front page
